other_conditions: Must be cultivating short‑term crops in Arunachal Pradesh.
Must hold a Kisan Credit Card or obtain a crop production loan from commercial banks, APRB or APSCAB Ltd.
Must have a good repayment track record and repay the loan within one year.
Loan amount limited to Rs 3 lakh.
Open to small, marginal, and large farmers.
No interest relief for perennial food crops or plantation crops.
benefits_summary: Zero‑interest crop loans up to ₹3 lakh with a 4% interest subvention (plus a 3% relief for timely repayment) for eligible farmers.
documents_required: Certificate of cultivated area and crops issued by the Circle Officer
Land Holding certificate from the concerned CO/EAC/BDO/SDO/ADC/DC office
